# AgileFlow

> Portable workflows for coding agents. AgileFlow installs, updates, forks, and evaluates standard Agent Skills (SKILL.md) in .agents/skills so Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI read them natively, and links them into .claude/skills for Claude Code. It installs no hooks, runs nothing while agents work, and changes no provider settings unless asked.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://docs.agileflow.projectquestorg.com/): What AgileFlow v5 is and is not.
- [Installation](https://docs.agileflow.projectquestorg.com/installation): Install the CLI; where files live.
- [Quick start](https://docs.agileflow.projectquestorg.com/quick-start): init, add, update.

- [fork and diff](https://docs.agileflow.projectquestorg.com/commands/fork-and-diff)
